questions.a: MEASUREMENT, NOT REFUSAL, is the shape CC would propose and it is Akien's to settle. An unmatched line has three innocent causes — he ruled in person, he ruled in another session, the transcript rotated — and a refusal turns all three into 'you cannot record that ruling'. A stamped field the hook can report keeps the fact loud (Law 7) without building a door that punishes him for not being at the terminal.

THIS IS NOT edge (h). Edge (h) says his words matching CC's READING of them (`now_the_spec_says`) is not derived and never was. This ticket is one layer beneath: whether his words are HIS WORDS. Both were unmeasured; only one was ever written down.

watchme: none, because the thing this ticket builds IS the standing check. A watch guards a property that could drift back after a build proves out; here the build's whole output is a measurement that runs at every intake, so a watch beside it would be the same question asked twice.
